```{r}
#Slope and NPQ Corrected CTD data
f <- read_csv(here("outputs", "corrected_flu_2025-04-10.csv"))
env <- read_csv(here("outputs", "enviro_ctd_nut_2025-04-15.csv"))
weath <- read_csv(here("outputs", "enviro_weather_2025-04-14.csv"))
```

```{r}
weath %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = Q_Total)) +
  geom_line()
```



```{r}
#Determining profile maximum concentration
f_max <- f %>% 
  group_by(date, station) %>% 
  slice_max(f_npq, with_ties = F) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(id, date, station, pres_max = pres, f_max = f_npq)

#Joining the profile maximum to the ctd data
fl2 <- f %>% 
  select(id, date, station, pres, f_npq) %>% 
  left_join(f_max) 

#Determining the full width half maximum of the fluorescence peaks.
fwhm <- fl2 %>% 
  select(id, date, station, pres, f_npq, f_max, pres_max) %>% 
  mutate(half_max = f_max/2) %>% #half max concentration
  mutate(position = case_when(pres < pres_max ~ "above", #above or below max depth
                              pres > pres_max ~ "below")) %>% 
  group_by(date, station, position) %>% 
  slice(which.min(abs(f_npq - half_max))) %>% #find closest value above/below to HM
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(id, fwhm_pres = pres, position, pres_max) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(position)) %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(n = n()) %>% #Should be 2 values (above/below), single means not met at surf
  ungroup()

#Joining fwhm to ctd profile data
fl3 <- fl2 %>% 
  left_join(fwhm) 

#Making FWHM depth above and below max separate columns and calculating diff
fl4 <- fl3 %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "position", values_from = "fwhm_pres") %>%
  mutate(scm_width = below - above)

#Calculating 50m integrated chlorophyll
int50 <- fl4 %>% 
  filter(pres < 51) %>% 
  group_by(id, date, station) %>% 
  summarise(int_50 = sum(f_npq)) %>% 
  ungroup()

f20p <- fl4 %>% 
  filter(pres < 51) %>% 
  mutate(f20p = f_max*0.2) %>% 
  filter(f_npq > f20p) %>% 
  group_by(date, station) %>% 
  summarise(n_f20p = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()

#Joing integrated chlorophyll back in to cTD profile data
fl5 <- fl4 %>% 
  left_join(int50) %>% 
  left_join(f20p)

#Pulling out different profile metrics.
scm_metrics <- fl5 %>% 
  select(id, date, station,
         f_max,
          pres_max,
         fwhm_shallow = above,
         fwhm_deep = below,
         scm_width,
         scm_width,
         int_50,
         n_f20p) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(max_int = (f_max/int_50)*100) 
```


```{r}
#Should look at where and when FZH01 and KC10 correlate.
```

```{r}
#These are meant to be daily means and they are not - go back to enviro and fix.
env_2 <- env %>% 
  select(date, dr_dm, r24_dep_dm) %>% 
  distinct()

n <- env %>% 
  select(date, pres, no2_dm) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  filter(pres == 1 | pres == 10) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = pres, values_from = no2_dm) %>% 
  rename(din_1 = `1`, din_10 = `10`)

s <- env %>% 
  select(date, pres, dsi = sio2_dm) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  filter(pres == 1 | pres == 10) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = pres, values_from = dsi) %>% 
  rename(dsi_1 = `1`, dsi_10 = `10`)

#These are daily means.
ctd_surf <- env %>% 
  select(date, pres, 
         n2_surf = N2, 
         rho_surf = rho, 
         sal_surf = sal, 
         temp_surf = temp) %>% 
  filter(pres < 2) %>% 
  select(-pres)

ctd_fmax <- env %>%    
  select(date, 
         pres_max = pres, 
         n2_fmax = N2, 
         rho_fmax = rho, 
         sal_fmax = sal, 
         temp_fmax = temp) 

scm_kc10 <- scm_metrics %>% 
  filter(station == "KC10")


```


```{r}
scm_correlate <- scm_kc10 %>% 
  filter(station == "KC10") %>% 
  left_join(weath) %>% 
  left_join(env_2) %>% 
  left_join(ctd_surf) %>% 
  left_join(ctd_fmax) %>% 
  left_join(n) %>% 
  left_join(s) %>% 
  distinct()
```
```{r}
scm_correlate %>% 
  mutate(month = month(date)) %>% 
  filter(station == "KC10") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(month), y = din_10, fill = station)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  ggsci::scale_fill_npg()
```

```{r}
cor2 <- scm_correlate %>% 
  select(f_max, pres_max, int_50, max_int, n_f20p, w_b1_3 = wind_b1_3,
         wd_b1_3, qt_b1_10:temp_surf, din_1, din_10) %>% 
  drop_na()

corr <- round(cor(cor2, method = "spearman"), 1)
p.mat <- cor_pmat(cor2)
```

```{r}
ggcorrplot(corr, p.mat = p.mat, hc.order = TRUE,
    type = "lower", insig = "blank", lab = T, lab_size = 10) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 30),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

ggsave(here("figures", "corello.png"), 
        width = 20, height = 20, dpi = 300)
```


```{r}
scm_correlate <- scm_correlate %>% 
  mutate(month = month(date),
         year = year(date))
```

```{r}
#Physics Fig
f1 <- scm_correlate %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = din_1, y = sal_surf, color = as.factor(month))) +
  geom_point(size = 6) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(x = bquote("DIN"[SURF]~"\u0020\u0028\u00B5mol\u0020L"^-1*")"),
       y = bquote("Salinity"[SURF])) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 30),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_text(color = 'black'),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_blank())

f2 <- scm_correlate %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = dr_dm, y = sal_surf, color = as.factor(month))) +
  geom_point(size = 6) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(x = bquote(Delta*rho~"("~kg~m^-3*")"),
       y = bquote("Salinity"[SURF]), 
       color = "Month") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 30),
        # legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_text(color = 'black'),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_blank())

f3 <- scm_correlate %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = din_1, y = temp_surf, color = as.factor(month))) +
  geom_point(size = 6) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(x = bquote("DIN"[SURF]~"\u0020\u0028\u00B5mol\u0020L"^-1*")"),
       y = bquote("Temp"[SURF]~"(°C)")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 30),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_text(color = 'black'),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_blank())

f4 <- scm_correlate %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = dr_dm, y = temp_surf, color = as.factor(month))) +
  geom_point(size = 6) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(x = bquote(Delta*rho["30-2m"]~"("*kg~m^-3*")"),
       y = bquote("Salinity"[SURF]), 
       color = "Month") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 30),
        # legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_text(color = 'black'),
        # axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_blank())

fig_phys <- f1 + f2 + f3 + f4 + plot_layout(guides = "collect")

ggsave(here("figures", "panel_physical.jpg"), fig_phys,
       width = 16, height = 14, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
  filter(month == 7) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = sal, y = pres, color = as.factor(year))) +

  geom_line(orientation = "y", size = 2) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(y = bquote("Depth (m)"),
       x = bquote("Salinity"), 
       color = "Year") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 30),

        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        # axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_blank())
```
